caption: The drawing depicts a tall, metal coffeepot with a long, curved spout and a wide, rounded handle. The body of the pot is predominantly a dark reddish-brown color, accented by painted decorative elements. Around the widest part of the pot and on the lid are bands of stylized leaf motifs in light green and yellow. The central portion of the pot features large, ornate floral designs in vibrant shades of green, red, and yellow, with the flowers outlined and shaded to provide a sense of depth. There are smaller blue-gray buds or flowers scattered across the surface. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige or cream color, with some faint smudges and marks visible. The artist's signature, "Frank H. Shap," appears near the bottom edge of the paper. The composition is centered, with the coffeepot occupying most of the space on the page.
title: Tin Teapot
